why: Questions whose only target concept was retired when the course was cut back to the concepts ARENA actually uses. Ids are POSITIONAL in the CSV sources, so retiring by id here is the only safe way to drop a drill: deleting the CSV row would renumber every question after it and silently re-point every qmatrix tag and every stored served_question_id. Nothing is deleted -- the rows stay in the CSVs and the pages stay in This-Directory-Only/archive/, so restoring a concept is removing its ids from this list.

split_kcs.why: Concepts whose PAGE is archived because the concept was SPLIT into narrower ones, not because it left the course. The id is gone from kc_registry.json and its page is filed in the archive beside the retired ones, so the archive watcher must know about it — but none of its drills were retired and nothing it taught was dropped.
